select sd.dept_id from sys_dept sd where sd.del_flag = '0' and sd.dept_id in ( select srd.dept_id from sys_role_dept srd where srd.role_id = #{roleId} )
and sd.dept_id not in ( select parent_id from sys_dept where dept_id in ( select srd.dept_id from sys_role_dept srd where srd.role_id = #{roleId} ) )
order by sd.parent_id asc, sd.order_num asc
